verdict.rationale: The pack shows an official API Reference (docs-24), APM tracing docs (docs-23), OpenTelemetry support (docs-2) and an official datadog-ci CLI (probe-4). Together these suggest first-party developer tooling to build against, but no item explicitly names official SDKs or client libraries, and the OpenAPI spec probe returned 404 at every candidate path, which limits spec-driven SDK generation. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of official SDKs/client libraries and their language coverage, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
